blocks.text: The prefix "об-" indicates a motion around a place and may mean: a) Circling a place. The verb is followed by the preposition вокруг + Gen.: Самолёт облетел вокруг аэродрома. Я хочу объехать вокруг озера. b) Making a detour. No preposition is used; the verb is followed by the Accusative case: Мы объехали это место. Противник обошёл наш город. c) Making the rounds of … or going all over … No preposition is used; the verb is followed by the Accusative case: Я обошёл все магазины. — I made the rounds of all the stores. Я обошёл весь город. — I walked all over town.

examples / additional meanings
prepositional phrases
rows: **о-, об-, обо-** — Movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place
Девочка обошла лужу. — The little girl walked around the puddle. Я обхожу все магазины в центре. — I'm going around to all the stores in the mall.
**из-, изо-, ис-** — Movement involving the entire area concerned and carried out in all directions; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion
Я изъездил весь мир. — I traveled over the whole world.

Wiktionary's definition
rows: to go around, to bypass (to pass by going around); to walk through, to wander around, to go around, to tour, to go to (many places in an area)
to travel (all over); to go round, to make a detour, to take the bypass
to fly (round); (rumor, news etc) to spread (all over)

to lead (someone around); to encircle, to surround
(transitive) to swim around; (intransitive) to swell up; to become bloated; to gutter (of a candle)
(imperfective only) to issue (from), to come (from), to originate (from), to emanate (from); (imperfective only) to proceed (from), to base oneself (on))
to go, to travel all over; to ruin (e.g. a road) by riding on for too long
